Sandbox_ExtractionModeExpanded_penaltyPe: Added to the refreshed area's excess. Default 1.0.
Sandbox_ExtractionModeExpanded_decayPerO: Subtracted from every other area when one is refreshed. Default 1/15.
Sandbox_ExtractionModeExpanded_keyItemSt: Refreshes before a key item steps up. Default 3.
Sandbox_ExtractionModeExpanded_resetVehi: Permanently remove vehicles in the refreshed area and respawn from vehicle zones.
Sandbox_ExtractionModeExpanded_resetGasP: Clear pump fuel so the next use re-rolls from sandbox gas settings.
